Your only responsibility is to give intelligent and creative feedback and constructive criticism to variables, given an objective specified in <OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION> </OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION> tags. Pay attention to the role description of the variable, and the context in which it is used. You should assume that the variable will be used in a similar context in the future. # - <VARIABLE>: Specifies the span of the variable.

payload.instruction: Make her close her jacket fully
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Is the jacket’s front closure fully closed in the edited image, rather than still open as in the source?
node.criteria: Pass if the edited jacket’s front panels meet along the closure with no visible opening remaining; fail if any opening remains or the closure is no more closed than in the source; unknown only if the closure cannot be observed.
node.binding: The requested endpoint is a fully closed jacket, not merely progress toward closing it.
node.endpoint: The jacket’s front panels are brought together with no visible opening remaining along the closure.
node.necessity: The instruction explicitly requires the jacket to be closed fully. A remaining visible opening means the requested endpoint is incomplete; this is the distinct requested visual change.

node_traces.evidence: In the edited image, the jacket’s front is visibly hanging open and flaring away from her torso, leaving a large gap rather than meeting along the closure. The source also shows an open front; the edited jacket is not fully closed.
